releaseNotes: Batch Fund & Dues Tracker Redesign: Compact, modern UI with 8dp spacing system and resolved button layout clipping
Single-Source Split Counts: Explicit student contribution counts in Dues Tracker without duplicate labels
Multi-Deposit Transparency: Clear labeling of total amounts and deposit counts for classmates who deposited multiple times
Relative Date Formatting: Friendly dates (Today, Yesterday, or 18 Nov 2026) across fund transactions
Notice Feed Alignment: Centered date badge positioning between notice cards and aligned Today pill
Resilient Notice Attachments: Fixed photo and PDF upload pipeline with real-time percentage progress and instant CDN delivery
Smart Notification Permission Prompt: Informative rationale bottom sheet explaining critical updates (urgent notices, class schedules, and batch funds)
Direct System Notification Settings: One-tap routing to app notification settings if permissions were previously denied
